base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a gleaming high-tech garage bay at the base of the lighthouse, tool walls, hoses, polishing cloths, a circular launch hatch in the floor. Lighting: cool workshop spotlights with copper reflections.
In the shot: Tomkin, an anthropomorphic tabby cat who walks upright, slim and wiry, with burnt-orange "artisanal copper" fur and darker copper tiger stripes, bright emerald-green eyes, long expressive whiskers, a smug confident half-smile, brass welding goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a leather tool belt full of tiny gadgets.
Camera: Medium tracking shot, then onto the hologram.
Action: Tomkin paces in tight circles, muttering about jelly, then stops dead and swipes up a glowing holographic map of a colourful nebula with a grey filing-cabinet icon at its centre.
Dialogue: Tomkin (crisp, rapid-fire, precise male tenor with a clipped British accent; superior, exasperated, always certain he is the only rational being in the room, commanding briefing) says: "Right! The squirrels have been kidnapped by the Grumpy Glitch-Bots of the Neon Nebula."
Sound effects: hologram whoosh, map zoom beeps, ambience of echoing garage, the hum of machinery.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly: same characters, same designs, same setting, same lighting and same 3D animated style (Tomkin).
Action: The hologram zooms into the grey filing-cabinet fortress as Tomkin narrows his eyes.
Dialogue: Tomkin (crisp, rapid-fire, precise male tenor with a clipped British accent; superior, exasperated, always certain he is the only rational being in the room, disgusted) says: "Grey. Humourless. Obsessed with organisation. The most boring crime in the universe."
Sound effects continue: hologram whoosh, map zoom beeps.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
